# Testing the inter-species hourglass model

Statistically test whether the two cell lineages (fusiform & ray lineages) share higher transcriptomic similarity at mid developmental stage.

## Setup

```{r Library}
library(Seurat, quietly = TRUE)
library(slingshot, quietly = TRUE)
library(dtw, quietly = TRUE)
library(sccore, quietly = TRUE)
library(magrittr, quietly = TRUE)
library(Matrix, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)
library(pheatmap, quietly = TRUE)
library(foreach, quietly = TRUE)
library(doSNOW, quietly = TRUE)
```

Params

```{r print markdown params}
params
```

Configure for parallel processing

```{r Configure for parallel processing}
Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1"
)
get_n_workers <- function(n_tasks, requested = params$n_parallel) {
  slurm_cpus <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", unset = NA_character_))
  )

  available <- if (is.na(slurm_cpus)) {
    max(1L, parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE) - 1L)
  } else {
    slurm_cpus
  }

  max(
    1L, 
    min(as.integer(requested), as.integer(n_tasks), available)
  )
}
make_parallel_progress <- function(n) {
  pb <- utils::txtProgressBar(
    min = 0,
    max = n,
    style = 3,
    file = stderr()
  )

  list(
    pb = pb,
    snow_options = list(
      progress = function(completed) {
        utils::setTxtProgressBar(
          pb,
          completed
        )
      },
      # Required for progress to update as individual tasks finish.
      preschedule = FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

## Single-copy orthogroups

Compare the fusiform-to-fiber and fusiform-to-vessel trajectories between species, separately. Keep exactly one locus per focal species **before** intersecting with expression features. By default, this applies the supplied four-species criterion (`PoT`, `EuG`, `LiC`, `TrA`), not only the two-species criterion.

```{r Read single-copy orthogroups}
orth <- read.csv(
  orthogroup_table,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
stopifnot(all(c("cluster_id", "species_name", "gene_name") %in% names(orth)))
orth_focal <- orth %>%
  dplyr::filter(species_name %in% focal_species) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(cluster_id, species_name, gene_name)
if (
  nrow(orth_focal) == 0L || anyNA(orth_focal) ||
  any(!nzchar(orth_focal$cluster_id)) || any(!nzchar(orth_focal$gene_name))
) {
  stop("The focal-species orthogroup memberships are empty or contain missing IDs.")
}

orth_copy_number <- orth_focal %>%
  dplyr::count(cluster_id, species_name, name = "n_loci") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    cluster_id,
    species_name = focal_species,
    fill = list(n_loci = 0L)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = species_name, values_from = n_loci)

single_copy_groups <- orth_copy_number[
  rowSums(as.matrix(orth_copy_number[, focal_species, drop = FALSE]) == 1L) ==
    length(focal_species),
  "cluster_id", drop = FALSE
]
orth_single_copy <- orth_focal %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(single_copy_groups, by = "cluster_id") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = cluster_id,
    names_from = species_name,
    values_from = gene_name
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster_id)
for (sp in names(species_codes)) {
  names(orth_single_copy)[names(orth_single_copy) == species_codes[[sp]]] <- sp
}
if (nrow(orth_single_copy) < 2L) {
  stop("Fewer than two single-copy orthogroups passed the focal-species criterion.")
}
for (sp in c(species_1, species_2)) {
  if (anyDuplicated(orth_single_copy[[sp]])) {
    stop("A ", sp, " gene is assigned to more than one retained orthogroup.")
  }
}
head(orth_single_copy)
```

Helper functions

```{r Define helper functions}
logcpm <- function(x) {
  log2(1 + 1e6 * sweep(as.matrix(x), 2, colSums(x), "/"))
}
calculate_js_similarity <- function(mat1, mat2) {
  # Use non-negative count-derived proportions, not log-CPM.
  mat <- cbind(mat1, mat2)
  mat <- sweep(mat, 2, colSums(mat), "/")
  out <- as.matrix(sccore::jsDist(mat))[
    seq_len(ncol(mat1)),
    ncol(mat1) + seq_len(ncol(mat2)),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  rownames(out) <- colnames(mat1)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat2)
  1 - out
}
calculate_similarity <- function(mat1, mat2, metrics) {
  stopifnot(
    metrics %in% c("spearman", "pearson", "Jensen-Shannon"),
    identical(rownames(mat1), rownames(mat2)),
    nrow(mat1) >= 2L,
    ncol(mat1) > 0L, ncol(mat2) > 0L
  )
  if (any(colSums(mat1) <= 0) || any(colSums(mat2) <= 0)) {
    stop("An expression bin has no counts for the retained single-copy orthogroups.")
  }
  out <- if (metrics %in% c("spearman", "pearson")) {
    cor(x = logcpm(mat1), y = logcpm(mat2), method = metrics)
  } else {
    calculate_js_similarity(as.matrix(mat1), as.matrix(mat2))
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(out))) {
    stop("Non-finite similarity; check empty bins or constant expression profiles.")
  }
  out
}

# Native gene IDs remain in each Seurat object for independent PCA/Slingshot.
# Only cross-species expression comparisons use aligned orthogroup IDs.
orthogroup_expression <- function(pb, species) {
  ids <- orth_expression[[species]]
  if (!all(ids %in% rownames(pb))) {
    stop("Some retained ", species, " genes are absent from the pseudobulk matrix.")
  }
  out <- pb[ids, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- orth_expression$cluster_id
  out
}
preprocess_seurat <- function(object) {
  object <- NormalizeData(object, verbose = FALSE)
  object <- FindVariableFeatures(object, verbose = FALSE)
  object <- ScaleData(object, features = VariableFeatures(object), verbose = FALSE)
  RunPCA(object, npcs = 10, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)
}
```

## Seurat preprocessing

```{r CreateSeuratObject}
read_sample <- function(path, sample_id) {
  counts <- Read10X_h5(path)
  if (is.list(counts)) {
    if (!"Gene Expression" %in% names(counts)) {
      stop("No Gene Expression matrix was found for ", sample_id)
    }
    counts <- counts[["Gene Expression"]]
  }
  CreateSeuratObject(counts, project = sample_id)
}
```

Import UMAP

```{r Import UMAP}
import_umap <- function(object, path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(object)
  emb <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(
    all(c("Barcode", "UMAP.1", "UMAP.2") %in% names(emb)),
    !anyDuplicated(emb$Barcode),
    all(Cells(object) %in% emb$Barcode)
  )
  rownames(emb) <- emb$Barcode
  emb <- as.matrix(emb[Cells(object), c("UMAP.1", "UMAP.2"), drop = FALSE])
  object[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = emb, key = "UMAP_", global = TRUE,
    assay = DefaultAssay(object)
  )
  object
}
seurat_obj_1 <- import_umap(seurat_obj_1, path_umap_1)
seurat_obj_2 <- import_umap(seurat_obj_2, path_umap_2)
plot_reduction_1 <- if ("umap" %in% Reductions(seurat_obj_1)) "umap" else "pca"
plot_reduction_2 <- if ("umap" %in% Reductions(seurat_obj_2)) "umap" else "pca"
```

Import per-cell labels generated by `Transfer_cell_label.Rmd`

```{r Import cell label}
import_cell_labels <- function(seurat_obj, path_cell_label, sample_id) {
  # Per-cell labels generated by Transfer_cell_label.Rmd.
  cell_label <- read.csv(
    path_cell_label,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  required_label_columns <- c(
    "Barcode",
    "cell_label"
  )

  missing_label_columns <- setdiff(
    required_label_columns,
    colnames(cell_label)
  )

  if (length(missing_label_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "The cell-label CSV is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_label_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(cell_label$Barcode)) {
    stop(
      "The cell-label CSV contains duplicated barcodes."
    )
  }

  # The transfer workflow should produce one row for every query cell.
  missing_barcodes <- setdiff(
    Cells(seurat_obj),
    cell_label$Barcode
  )
  extra_barcodes <- setdiff(
    cell_label$Barcode,
    Cells(seurat_obj)
  )

  if (length(missing_barcodes) > 0L) {
    stop(
      length(missing_barcodes),
      " Seurat cells are absent from the cell-label CSV. ",
      "Check that path_cell_label belongs to sample_id."
    )
  }

  if (length(extra_barcodes) > 0L) {
    warning(
      length(extra_barcodes),
      " CSV barcodes are absent from the Seurat object and will be ignored."
    )
  }

  # Check sample identity when Transfer_cell_label.Rmd recorded it.
  if (
    "query_sample_id" %in% colnames(cell_label) &&
    any(!is.na(cell_label$query_sample_id))
  ) {
    query_sample_ids <- unique(
      cell_label$query_sample_id[
        !is.na(cell_label$query_sample_id)
      ]
    )

    if (
      length(query_sample_ids) != 1L ||
      !identical(
        as.character(query_sample_ids),
        as.character(sample_id)
      )
    ) {
      stop(
        "The query_sample_id recorded in the cell-label CSV does not match ",
        "sample_id."
      )
    }
  }

  if (keep_only_transfer_pass) {
    if (!"transfer_pass" %in% colnames(cell_label)) {
      stop(
        "keep_only_transfer_pass = TRUE, but the cell-label CSV has no ",
        "transfer_pass column."
      )
    }

    transfer_pass <- cell_label$transfer_pass %in% c(
      TRUE, 1, "1", "TRUE", "True", "true"
    )
    cell_label$cell_label[!transfer_pass] <- NA_character_
  }

  cell_labels_by_barcode <- cell_label$cell_label[
    match(
      Cells(seurat_obj),
      cell_label$Barcode
    )
  ]

  names(cell_labels_by_barcode) <- Cells(seurat_obj)

  # Add labels to the Seurat object. Unassigned or unsupported states
  # become NA because only the prespecified developmental states are retained.
  seurat_obj$cell_label <- factor(
    cell_labels_by_barcode,
    levels = cluster_levels
  )

  # Remove cells without an accepted developmental-state label. When cells
  # are removed, re-estimate the PCA used by Slingshot from the retained cells.
  keep_cells <- Cells(seurat_obj)[
    !is.na(seurat_obj$cell_label)
  ]

  if (length(keep_cells) == 0L) {
    stop("No accepted fusiform cells remain for ", sample_id)
  }
  if (length(keep_cells) < ncol(seurat_obj)) {
    message(
      ncol(seurat_obj) - length(keep_cells),
      " cells were excluded because no accepted fusiform cell label was available."
    )

    seurat_obj <- subset(
      seurat_obj,
      cells = keep_cells
    )

    seurat_obj <- preprocess_seurat(seurat_obj)
  }

  Idents(seurat_obj) <- "cell_label"

  required_labels <- unique(unlist(lineage_cell_types))
  missing_labels <- setdiff(
    required_labels,
    unique(as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label))
  )

  if (length(missing_labels) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Required developmental states are missing: ",
      paste(missing_labels, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  seurat_obj
}
seurat_obj_1 <- import_cell_labels(seurat_obj_1, path_cell_label_1, params$sample_id_1)
seurat_obj_2 <- import_cell_labels(seurat_obj_2, path_cell_label_2, params$sample_id_2)
```

Match single-copy genes to both count matrices. Gene IDs must match exactly; transcript/version suffixes are not removed automatically. Exclude orthogroups with zero total counts in either retained fusiform population. Use all remaining single-copy orthogroups, not the intersection of species-specific highly variable genes.

```{r Match orthogroups to expression}
orth_expression <- orth_single_copy[
  orth_single_copy[[species_1]] %in% rownames(seurat_obj_1) &
    orth_single_copy[[species_2]] %in% rownames(seurat_obj_2),
  , drop = FALSE
]
if (nrow(orth_expression) < 2L) {
  stop("Too few single-copy genes match both expression matrices; check gene IDs.")
}
counts_1 <- LayerData(seurat_obj_1, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
counts_2 <- LayerData(seurat_obj_2, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
expressed_1 <- Matrix::rowSums(counts_1[orth_expression[[species_1]], , drop = FALSE]) > 0
expressed_2 <- Matrix::rowSums(counts_2[orth_expression[[species_2]], , drop = FALSE]) > 0
orth_expression <- orth_expression[expressed_1 & expressed_2, , drop = FALSE]
genes <- orth_expression$cluster_id
rm(counts_1, counts_2)
if (length(genes) < 2L) stop("Too few single-copy orthogroups are expressed in both species.")
message(
  nrow(orth_single_copy), " single-copy orthogroups; ",
  length(genes), " matched and expressed in both fusiform populations."
)
head(orth_expression)
```

Pairwise transcriptomic similarity among discrete cell states

```{r Discrete stages hourlgass}
pb_discrete_1 <- orthogroup_expression(
  AggregateExpression(seurat_obj_1, assays = "RNA", group.by = "cell_label")$RNA,
  species_1
)
pb_discrete_2 <- orthogroup_expression(
  AggregateExpression(seurat_obj_2, assays = "RNA", group.by = "cell_label")$RNA,
  species_2
)
similarity_discrete <- calculate_similarity(
  pb_discrete_1[, fusiform_lineage, drop = FALSE],
  pb_discrete_2[, fusiform_lineage, drop = FALSE],
  metrics = params$metric
)
p_similarity_discrete <- pheatmap(
  similarity_discrete,
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f",
  main = sprintf("Fusiform: %s (rows) vs %s (columns)\n(%s)",
                 species_1, species_2, params$metric)
)
```

## Test hourglass along pseudotime

**The procedure:**

1.  Infer fusiform pseudotime independently in each species using Slingshot based on its own PCA coordinates.

2.  Aggregate expression by pseudotime bins (by `n_bins`).

3.  Calculate pairwise similarity between species within each fusiform branch using matched single-copy orthogroups (using `metric`).

4.  Align the corresponding species-specific branches by Dynamic Time Warping (DTW), using `window_dtw`. Species 1 is the query; species 2 is the reference.

5.  Calculate the `hourglass score` based on cell lineage alignment.

    Hourglass score is defined as follows:

    Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

    $$
    E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
    M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
    L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
    $$

    The hourglass score was then defined as

    $$
    H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
    $$

    A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

6.  Permutation for the null distribution of the hourglass score\

    (1) Shuffle pseudotime values\
    (2) Repeat Step 2-5\
    (3) Estimate permutation p-value

7.  Bootstrapping for the confidence interval of the hourglass score\

    (1) Re-sample cells with replacement\
    (2) Repeat Step 1-5\
    (3) Estimate bootstrap confidence interval

### 1. Pseudotime inference

Slingshot pseudotimes were inferred based on PCA coordinates

```{r Create SlingshotDataSet}
slingshot_manual <- function(seurat_obj) {
  missing_labels <- setdiff(unique(unlist(lineage_cell_types)),
                            as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label))
  if (length(missing_labels)) {
    stop("Required fusiform states are missing: ", paste(missing_labels, collapse = ", "))
  }
  lineages <- new("SlingshotDataSet")

  # add cell embedding
  lineages@reducedDim <- seurat_obj %>% 
    Embeddings(reduction = "pca") %>% 
    extract(1:dim(seurat_obj)[2], 1:10) %>%
    as.matrix
  
  # add cluster matrix
  clusters <- factor(seurat_obj$cell_label, levels = cluster_levels)
  mtx_clus <- matrix(0, nrow=length(clusters), ncol=length(levels(clusters)))
  rownames(mtx_clus) <- Cells(seurat_obj)
  colnames(mtx_clus) <- levels(clusters)
  mtx_clus[cbind(seq_along(clusters), as.integer(clusters))] <- 1
  lineages@clusterLabels <- mtx_clus
  
  # add lineages
  lineages@lineages <- lineage_cell_types
  
  # add adjacency matrix
  mtx_adj <- matrix(0, nrow = length(levels(clusters)), ncol = length(levels(clusters)))
  row.names(mtx_adj) <- colnames(mtx_adj) <- levels(clusters)
  for (l_i in lineages@lineages) {
    for (c_i in seq(length(l_i) - 1)) {
      mtx_adj[l_i[c_i], l_i[c_i + 1]] <- 1
      mtx_adj[l_i[c_i + 1], l_i[c_i]] <- 1
    }
  }
  lineages@adjacency <- mtx_adj
  
  # fit curves
  curves <- getCurves(
    lineages,
    approx_points = 100,
    reassign = FALSE
  ) %>% SlingshotDataSet
  
  # estimate pseudotime
  pseudotime <- slingPseudotime(
    curves,
    na = FALSE
  )
  # Explicit label membership prevents terminal Fiber/Vessel cross-assignment.
  allowed <- vapply(lineage_cell_types, function(states) {
    as.character(clusters) %in% states
  }, logical(ncol(seurat_obj)))
  pseudotime[!allowed] <- NA_real_
  rownames(pseudotime) <- Cells(seurat_obj)
  branch_id <- apply(allowed, 1, function(x) paste(which(x), collapse = ","))
  names(branch_id) <- Cells(seurat_obj)
  return(
    list(
      SlingshotDataSet = curves,
      pseudotime = pseudotime,
      branch_id = branch_id
    )
  )
}
```

### 2. Bin expression by pseudotime

Expression was aggregated within equal-width pseudotime bins independently for each lineage.

Corresponding fusiform branches from the two species were subsequently aligned using a constrained monotonic DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) path.

```{r Bin expression}
bin_expression <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    pseudotime_mtx, 
    branch_id, 
    lineage,
    exclude = c(),
    prefix, 
    n_bins
) {
  # get pseudotime values
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(pseudotime_mtx), Cells(seurat_obj)))
  pt <- pseudotime_mtx[, lineage]
  names(pt) <- Cells(seurat_obj)

  # keep only cells belongs to the lineage
  keep <- grepl(paste0("(^|,)", lineage, "(,|$)"), branch_id)
  keep <- keep & seurat_obj$cell_label %in% lineage_cell_types[[lineage]] &
    !seurat_obj$cell_label %in% exclude & is.finite(pt)
  pt <- pt[keep]
  if (length(pt) < 2L || diff(range(pt)) <= 0) {
    stop("Too few cells or no pseudotime range for ", prefix)
  }

  # set bins 
  bins <- cut(
    pt, 
    breaks = seq(
      min(pt),
      max(pt),
      length.out = n_bins + 1    
    ),
    labels = FALSE, 
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )
  names(bins) <- names(pt)
  
  # subset lineage cells
  obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = names(pt))
  obj$bin <- sprintf("%s-%02d", prefix, bins[colnames(obj)])
  
  # aggregate pseudotime
  pb <- AggregateExpression(obj, assays = "RNA", group.by = "bin")$RNA
  pb <- pb[, order(colnames(pb)), drop = FALSE]
  
  # report cell label composition by bins
  comp <- table(
    bin = factor(bins, levels = seq_len(n_bins)),
    cell_type = seurat_obj$cell_label[keep]
  )
  return(list(Pseudobulk = pb, Composition = comp))
}
```

Identify middle-stage query bins separately for each fusiform branch. A bin is middle-stage when the combined fraction of `middle_cell_types` exceeds `middle_fraction`. Require one contiguous middle interval, with occupied early and late intervals; otherwise stop rather than redefine the stage from the similarity curve. The same rule is used in each bootstrap. Empty query bins require fewer bins or inspection of the trajectory.

```{r Record bin-stage correspondance}
get_stage_modules <- function(comp) {
  totals <- rowSums(comp)
  if (any(totals == 0)) {
    stop("The species-1 query has empty pseudotime bins; reduce n_bins or inspect the trajectory.")
  }
  fraction <- rowSums(comp[, middle_cell_types, drop = FALSE]) / totals
  middle <- as.integer(rownames(comp)[fraction > middle_fraction])
  middle <- middle[c(FALSE, diff(middle) == 1) | c(diff(middle) == 1, FALSE)]
  # if (!length(middle) || any(diff(middle) != 1L)) {
  #   stop("No single contiguous precursor-majority middle interval; inspect bin composition.")
  # }
  if (min(middle) <= 1L || max(middle) >= nrow(comp)) {
    stop("The middle interval reaches a trajectory endpoint; early/middle/late are not all defined.")
  }
  list(
    early = seq_len(min(middle) - 1L),
    middle = middle,
    late = seq.int(max(middle) + 1L, nrow(comp))
  )
}
modules <- list(
  L1 = get_stage_modules(comp_L1_1),
  L2 = get_stage_modules(comp_L2_1)
)
```

### 4. Align pseudotime bins

Find the correspondence between lineage pseudotime by the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm:

```{r Define align_similarity_matrix}
align_similarity_matrix <- function(
  similarity,
  window_size = ceiling(window_dtw * max(dim(similarity)))
) {
  local_cost <- 1 - similarity
  fit <- dtw(
    x = local_cost,
    y = NULL,
    step.pattern = dtw::asymmetric, # Each species-1 query bin is matched exactly once.
    window.type = "slantedband",
    window.size = window_size,
    open.begin = TRUE,
    open.end = TRUE,
    keep.internals = TRUE,
    distance.only = FALSE
  )

  if (!identical(as.integer(fit$index1), seq_len(nrow(similarity)))) {
    stop("DTW did not match each query bin exactly once.")
  }
  path <- tibble::tibble(
    L1_i = fit$index1,
    L2_i = fit$index2,
    L1_bin = rownames(similarity)[fit$index1],
    L2_bin = colnames(similarity)[fit$index2],
    similarity = similarity[
      cbind(fit$index1, fit$index2)
    ]
  )
  list(
    fit = fit,
    path = path,
    local_cost = local_cost
  )
}
```

```{r Plot DTW path}
plot_dtw_path <- function(
  similarity,
  aligned,
  title
) {
  similarity <- as.matrix(similarity)

  stopifnot(
    max(aligned$path$L1_i) <= nrow(similarity),
    max(aligned$path$L2_i) <= ncol(similarity)

    L1_i = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
    L2_i = seq_len(ncol(similarity))

    cbind(
      heatmap_data$L1_i,
      heatmap_data$L2_i
    )

      x = L2_i,
```

Summarize cell type correspondence along the aligned path

```{r}
composition_proportions <- function(comp, states) {
  comp <- as.matrix(comp)
  out <- matrix(
    0, nrow = nrow(comp), ncol = length(states), 
    dimnames = list(rownames(comp), states)
  )
  shared_states <- intersect(colnames(comp), states)

  out[, shared_states] <- comp[, shared_states, drop = FALSE]

  totals <- rowSums(out)

  sweep(out, 1, pmax(totals, 1), "/")
}
extract_bin_id <- function(x) {
  x %>% 
    sub("^.*-(\\d+)$", "\\1", .) %>%
    as.integer %>%
    as.character
}
alignment_label_mass <- function(
    aligned,
    comp_query,
    comp_reference,
    query_states,
    reference_states
) {
  # get cell state proportion in
  query_prop <- composition_proportions(comp_query, query_states)
  reference_prop <- composition_proportions(comp_reference, reference_states)

  # get alignment path
  path <- aligned$path
  query_bin <- extract_bin_id(path$L1_bin)
  reference_bin <- extract_bin_id(path$L2_bin)

  
  mass <- matrix(
    0, nrow = length(query_states), ncol = length(reference_states),
    dimnames = list(query_state = query_states, reference_state = reference_states)
  )

  for (k in seq_len(nrow(path))) {
    mass <- mass + tcrossprod(
        query_prop[query_bin[k], , drop = TRUE],
        reference_prop[reference_bin[k], , drop = TRUE]
      )
  }

  # Equal weight for each species-1 query pseudotime position.
  mass <- mass / nrow(path)

  stopifnot(
    isTRUE(all.equal(sum(mass), 1, tolerance = 1e-8))
  )

  mass
}
```

### 5. Calculate hourglass score

Hourglass score is defined as follows:

Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

$$
E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
$$

The hourglass score was then defined as

$$
H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
$$

A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

```{r Define function for calculating hourglass scores}
hourglass_score <- function(S, modules) {
  indices <- unlist(modules, use.names = FALSE)
  stopifnot(
    all(lengths(modules) > 0L),
    all(indices >= 1L & indices <= length(S)),
    all(is.finite(S[indices]))
  )
  E <- mean(S[modules$early], na.rm = TRUE)
  M <- mean(S[modules$middle], na.rm = TRUE)
  L <- mean(S[modules$late], na.rm = TRUE)
  c(
    Early = E,
    Middle = M,
    Late = L,
    H = min(M - E, M - L)
  )
}
```

```{r Calculate the hourglass score}
scores_observed <- rbind(
  hourglass_score(S_L1, modules$L1),
  hourglass_score(S_L2, modules$L2)
) %>% 
  as.data.frame %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    comparison = c("Fiber-Fiber", "Vessel-Vessel"),
    permutation = "Observed"
  )

scores_observed
```

### 6. Permutation test

Permute species-1 pseudotimes within each prescribed fusiform branch while keeping species 2 fixed. A shared random cell ordering couples the two branch permutations for their shared precursors. This preserves each branch's pseudotime values and bin occupancy, but randomizes their association with expression. Recalculate pseudobulks, similarities and DTW for every permutation; keep the observed middle-stage coordinates and orthogroup universe fixed.

```{r Permutation test, echo=TRUE, results='hide'}
# One shared random ordering, restricted to the eligible cells of each branch.
permute_pseudotime <- function(pseudotime, branch_id, cell_labels) {
  priority <- sample.int(nrow(pseudotime))
  out <- pseudotime
  for (j in seq_along(lineage_cell_types)) {
    keep <- grepl(paste0("(^|,)", j, "(,|$)"), branch_id) &
      cell_labels %in% lineage_cell_types[[j]] & is.finite(pseudotime[, j])
    out[keep, j] <- sort(pseudotime[keep, j])[rank(priority[keep], ties.method = "first")]
  }
  out
}
n_permutation <- as.integer(params$n_permutation)
metric <- as.character(params$metric)
set.seed(42)
permutation_seeds <- sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, n_permutation, replace = FALSE)
n_workers_perm <- get_n_workers(n_permutation)
message("Running ", n_permutation, " permutations on ", n_workers_perm, " workers.")
cl_perm <- parallel::makeCluster(n_workers_perm)
registerDoSNOW(cl_perm)
perm_progress <- make_parallel_progress(n_permutation)

scores_perm_list <- tryCatch(
  {
    foreach::foreach(
      i = seq_len(n_permutation),
      .inorder = FALSE,
      .options.snow = perm_progress$snow_options,
      .packages = c("Seurat", "Matrix", "magrittr", "dtw", "sccore", "tibble")
    ) %dopar% {
      set.seed(permutation_seeds[i])
      pt_i <- permute_pseudotime(pseudotime_1, branch_id_1, seurat_obj_1$cell_label)
      reference_pb <- list(pb_L1_2, pb_L2_2)
      score_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:2, function(j) {
        binned <- bin_expression(
          seurat_obj_1, pt_i, branch_id_1,
          lineage = j, n_bins = n_bins,
          prefix = paste0(species_1, "-", c("Fiber", "Vessel")[j])
        )
        query_pb <- orthogroup_expression(binned$Pseudobulk, species_1)
        similarity <- calculate_similarity(reference_pb[[j]], query_pb, metric)
        aligned <- align_similarity_matrix(t(similarity))
        hourglass_score(aligned$path$similarity, modules[[j]])
      }))
      data.frame(
        score_matrix, comparison = comparison_names,
        permutation = sprintf("Permutation-%d", i),
        seed = permutation_seeds[i], row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE
      )
    }
  },
  finally = {
    close(perm_progress$pb)
    parallel::stopCluster(cl_perm)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }
)
scores_perm <- dplyr::bind_rows(scores_perm_list)
```

Calculate the permutation p-value

```{r Calculate the permutation p-value}
observed_H <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_obs = H
  )

permutation_results <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(H)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    permutation,
    comparison,
    H_perm = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    observed_H,
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_obs = dplyr::first(H_obs),
    n_permutation = dplyr::n_distinct(permutation),
    n_null_ge_observed = sum(H_perm >= dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    null_mean = mean(H_perm),
    null_median = median(H_perm),
    null_sd = stats::sd(H_perm),
    null_q025 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.025)),
    null_q95 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.95)),
    null_q975 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.975)),
    observed_minus_null_mean = dplyr::first(H_obs) - mean(H_perm),
    observed_percentile = mean(H_perm < dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # One-sided empirical permutation P value
    p_empirical = (n_null_ge_observed + 1) / (n_permutation + 1),
    # Adjust p-value
    p_holm = stats::p.adjust(p_empirical, method = "holm")
  )

permutation_results
```

#### Calculate the one-sided joint permutation $P$-value using $H_{\mathrm{joint}}=\min(H_{\mathrm{Fiber\text{-}Fiber}},H_{\mathrm{Vessel\text{-}Vessel}})$, as the proportion of permuted joint scores at least as large as the observed joint score.

```{r Calcualte the joint p-value}
H_joint_observed <- min(scores_observed$H)
H_joint_perm <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::select(
    permutation,
    comparison,
    H
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    H_joint = pmin(
      `Fiber-Fiber`,
      `Vessel-Vessel`
    )
  )

p_joint <- (
  sum(H_joint_perm$H_joint >= H_joint_observed) + 1L
) / (
  nrow(H_joint_perm) + 1L
)
p_joint
```

### 7. Bootstrapping

Independently resample cells with replacement within each species. Repeat native-gene preprocessing, PCA, Slingshot, binning, query-stage definition and DTW, using the same observed single-copy orthogroup universe. These are cell-bootstrap intervals for this sample pair, not biological-replicate confidence intervals. Failed replicate counts must be inspected.

```{r Define bootstrapping helper functions}
# Re-sampling cells from a SeuratObject with replacement
make_bootstrap_seurat <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    seed,
    assay = "RNA"
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  n_cells <- ncol(seurat_obj)

  # Bootstrap draw: integer indices preserve repeated selections.
  sampled_idx <- sample.int(
    n = n_cells,
    size = n_cells,
    replace = TRUE
  )

  source_cells <- Cells(seurat_obj)[sampled_idx]

  # Extract raw counts, preserving duplicated columns.
  counts_boot <- LayerData(
    seurat_obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )[, sampled_idx, drop = FALSE]

  # Every bootstrap draw requires its own unique object-level ID.
  bootstrap_cells <- sprintf(
    "Boot-%05d__%s",
    seq_len(n_cells),
    source_cells
  )

  colnames(counts_boot) <- bootstrap_cells

  # Copy metadata according to the same sampled indices.
  meta_boot <- seurat_obj[[]][
    sampled_idx,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  meta_boot$source_cell <- source_cells
  meta_boot$bootstrap_draw <- seq_len(n_cells)

  rownames(meta_boot) <- bootstrap_cells

  # Let CreateSeuratObject recalculate these fields.
  qc_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      paste0("nCount_", assay),
      paste0("nFeature_", assay)
    ),
    colnames(meta_boot)
  )

  meta_boot <- meta_boot[
    ,
    setdiff(colnames(meta_boot), qc_columns),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  object_boot <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts_boot,
    assay = assay,
    meta.data = meta_boot,
    project = paste0(Project(seurat_obj), "_bootstrap")
  )

  # Preserve your published biological labels.
  if ("cell_label" %in% colnames(object_boot[[]])) {
    Idents(object_boot) <- "cell_label"
  }

  list(
    object = object_boot,
    sampled_idx = sampled_idx,
    source_cells = source_cells
  )
}


run_bootstrap_once <- function(seed) {
  on.exit(gc(), add = TRUE)
  tryCatch({
    # Independent cell resampling in the two species; retain both branch endpoints.
    # Missing states/empty query bins are recorded as failed replicates, not imputed.
    set.seed(seed)
    sample_seeds <- sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, 2L)
    objects_i <- list(
      make_bootstrap_seurat(seurat_obj_1, sample_seeds[1])$object,
      make_bootstrap_seurat(seurat_obj_2, sample_seeds[2])$object
    )
    objects_i <- lapply(objects_i, preprocess_seurat)
    slingshot_i <- lapply(objects_i, slingshot_manual)
    score_list <- mass_list <- vector("list", 2L)
    for (j in 1:2) {
      query <- bin_expression(
        objects_i[[1]], slingshot_i[[1]]$pseudotime, slingshot_i[[1]]$branch_id,
        lineage = j, n_bins = n_bins,
        prefix = paste0(species_1, "-", c("Fiber", "Vessel")[j])
      )
      reference <- bin_expression(
        objects_i[[2]], slingshot_i[[2]]$pseudotime, slingshot_i[[2]]$branch_id,
        lineage = j, n_bins = n_bins,
        prefix = paste0(species_2, "-", c("Fiber", "Vessel")[j])
      )
      modules_i <- get_stage_modules(query$Composition)
      # Fixed observed single-copy feature universe; never reselect native HVGs here.
      query_pb <- orthogroup_expression(query$Pseudobulk, species_1)
      reference_pb <- orthogroup_expression(reference$Pseudobulk, species_2)
      similarity <- calculate_similarity(reference_pb, query_pb, metric)
      aligned <- align_similarity_matrix(t(similarity))
      score_list[[j]] <- hourglass_score(aligned$path$similarity, modules_i)
      mass_list[[j]] <- alignment_label_mass(
        aligned, query$Composition, reference$Composition,
        lineage_cell_types[[j]], lineage_cell_types[[j]]
      )
    }
    names(mass_list) <- comparison_names
    list(
      ok = TRUE, seed = seed,
      scores = data.frame(
        do.call(rbind, score_list), comparison = comparison_names,
        bootstrap = seed, row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE
      ),
      alignment_mass = mass_list, error = NA_character_
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(ok = FALSE, seed = seed, scores = NULL,
         alignment_mass = NULL, error = conditionMessage(e))
  })
}
```

Run bootstraps

```{r Run bootstraps, echo=TRUE, results='hide'}
# get params
n_bootstrap <- as.integer(params$n_bootstrap)
n_bins <- as.integer(params$n_bins)
metric <- as.character(params$metric)

# get bootstrap seeds
set.seed(42)
bootstrap_seeds <- sample.int(
  n = .Machine$integer.max,
  size = n_bootstrap,
  replace = FALSE
)

# register paralelle backend
n_workers_boot <- get_n_workers(
  n_tasks = n_bootstrap
)
cl_boot <- parallel::makeCluster(
  n_workers_boot
)
registerDoSNOW(
  cl_boot
)
message(
  "Running ", n_bootstrap, " bootstrap replicates on ", 
  foreach::getDoParWorkers(), " workers."
)

# create progress bar
boot_progress <- make_parallel_progress(
  n_bootstrap
)


# run
bootstrap_output <- tryCatch(
  {
    foreach::foreach(
      seed = bootstrap_seeds,
      .inorder = FALSE,
      .packages = c(
        "Seurat",
        "slingshot",
        "Matrix",
        "magrittr",
        "dtw",
        "sccore",
        "tibble",
        "dplyr"
      ),
      .options.snow = boot_progress$snow_options
    ) %dopar% {
      run_bootstrap_once(seed)
    }
  },
  finally = {
    close(boot_progress$pb)
    parallel::stopCluster(cl_boot)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }
)
```

Check for failed bootstraps

```{r Check for failed bootstraps}
if (any(!bootstrap_ok)) {
  bootstrap_errors <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      bootstrap_output[!bootstrap_ok],
      function(x) {
        data.frame(
          bootstrap = x$seed,
          error = x$error,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  )
} else {
  bootstrap_errors <- data.frame(
    bootstrap = integer(),
    error = character()
  )
}

message(
  sum(bootstrap_ok),
  " valid bootstrap replicates; ",
  sum(!bootstrap_ok),
  " failed replicates."
)

head(bootstrap_errors)
if (sum(bootstrap_ok) < 2L) {
  stop("Fewer than two valid bootstrap replicates. Inspect bootstrap_errors before interpreting the analysis.")
}
if (any(!bootstrap_ok)) {
  warning("Some bootstrap replicates failed; intervals are conditional on successful replicates. Inspect bootstrap_errors.")
}
```

Check cell type alignment

```{r}
summarize_alignment_mass <- function(
    bootstrap_output,
    bootstrap_ok,
    comparison
) {
  mass_list <- lapply(
    bootstrap_output[bootstrap_ok],
    function(x) {
      x$alignment_mass[[comparison]]
    }
  )

  mass_array <- simplify2array(mass_list)

  list(
    mean = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), mean),
    median = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), median),
    lower = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.025),
    upper = apply(mass_array,c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.975),
    array = mass_array
  )
}
```

#### Calculate confidence interval

```{r Calculate confidence interval}
scores_observed_ci <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

scores_bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap_ci %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bootstrap = dplyr::n_distinct(bootstrap),

    H_median = median(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    H_ci_lower = unname(quantile(H, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    H_ci_upper = unname(quantile(H, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_E_median = median(M_minus_E, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_E_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_E_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_L_median = median(M_minus_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_L_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_L_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scores_observed_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_observed = H,
        M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
        M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_observed,
    H_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_E_ci_lower,
    M_minus_E_ci_upper,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    M_minus_L_ci_lower,
    M_minus_L_ci_upper,
    n_bootstrap
  )

bootstrap_ci
```

#### Calculate joint confidence interval

```{r Calculate joint confidence interval}
H_joint_observed <- min(
  scores_observed$H
)

H_joint_bootstrap <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::select(bootstrap, comparison, H) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(`Fiber-Fiber`),
    is.finite(`Vessel-Vessel`)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    H_joint = pmin(
      `Fiber-Fiber`,
      `Vessel-Vessel`
    )
  )

joint_bootstrap_ci <- H_joint_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_joint_observed = H_joint_observed,
    H_joint_median = median(
      H_joint,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    H_joint_ci_lower = unname(quantile(H_joint, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    H_joint_ci_upper = unname(quantile(H_joint, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_bootstrap = sum(is.finite(H_joint))
  )

joint_bootstrap_ci
```

## Write key data

Write one long CSV containing the observed scores and the complete permutation and bootstrap distributions. Both species are recorded explicitly; the legacy `sample_id` and `individual_id` fields identify the pair. A downstream biological-replicate analysis must account for any samples reused across pairs.

```{r Prepare key data}
get_param_or <- function(name, default) {
  value <- params[[name]]

  if (
    is.null(value) ||
    length(value) == 0L ||
    all(is.na(value)) ||
    !nzchar(as.character(value)[1])
  ) {
    return(default)
  }

  as.character(value)[1]
}

  sample_id_1 = as.character(params$sample_id_1),
  sample_id_2 = as.character(params$sample_id_2),
  species_1 = species_1,
  species_2 = species_2,
  individual_id_1 = get_param_or("individual_id_1", params$sample_id_1),
  individual_id_2 = get_param_or("individual_id_2", params$sample_id_2),
  condition_1 = get_param_or("condition_1", "unspecified"),
  condition_2 = get_param_or("condition_2", "unspecified"),
  batch_1 = get_param_or("batch_1", "unspecified"),
  batch_2 = get_param_or("batch_2", "unspecified")
)
```

```{r Save workspace image}
save.image(file = params$path_image)
```
